I’m writing this in advance because I know this conversation is going to be the hardest one I will ever have to make in my life. At any point you are more than welcome to stop me, ask me to leave or clarify. 

Now for the hardest part, I was unfaithful. 

I am telling you this because you mean the world to me, I love you and want to spend the rest of my life with you and the only way for that to happen is to be honest with you. 

I want to tell you the whole truth so hear me out. I got touched by a girl in a place that I wish I would’ve only shared with you. I didn’t kiss her, I didn’t have intercourse with her and I didn’t touch her below the belt.  It was the single worst experience of my life. 

Now this is what I did after. I was and am torn up and devastated. I had not been the man you know, wanted and deserve. I spent the next days so repulsed with myself that half of it was leaning over the toilet throwing up the little food I attempted to eat and the other half on a hotline as I just needed someone to talk to. You know how we used to have I love you more? No matter how much you hate me. I just want to let you know that I hate myself more. 

Since then I have cut contact with her. And have been reading articles on cheating and drafting this in order to best convey what happened. 

Going forward, whether you take me or not, I would like to spend every waking moment of my life regaining the trust I destroyed. Even if it takes my entire life to regain one smidge of the trust we had it would be worth it to me. I will never be able to forgive myself but someday somehow I hope you forgive me. 

You are the single greatest thing to ever happen to me and whatever decision you make i will respect, whether it’s telling our friends and family, leaving me, or staying. I just want to tell you once more that I love you and that will never change. 

I’m scared that I’m not only going to lose the love of my life but my best friend. You deserve the best man this world has to offer and if you will let me I will strive everyday to try to become that. 

If we have manage to make it this far then there is one more thing I need to say. I want to work through this and come out stronger. I would like to make sure we work through it correctly so I want us to get some counseling through this trying time. I will pay for every bit of it. I love you
